title: Integrated bioinformatic pipeline for identifying cancer-related germline variants
author: Sahu, Chatrath, et al.

steps.title: Clone protocol repository
steps.instruction: Open a Linux command‑line interface and run the git clone command to download the STAR_protocols_GV_calling directory from GitHub.

substeps.instruction: Wait ~5 min for the repository to download.

steps.title: Set protocol directory path
steps.instruction: Define an environment variable pointing to the cloned repository and make it available in future sessions.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the cloned folder and obtain its absolute path with pwd (e.g., /home/dsahu/project).
Append the line: export protocol_dir="/home/dsahu/project" to the end of the file.
Save and exit (Ctrl+X, then Y, then Enter).

steps.title: Call variants with VarDictJava
steps.instruction: Run VarDictJava to call germline variants for each of the three data types: wxs‑normal, wxs‑tumor, and rnaseq‑tumor.

steps.title: Preprocess VCFs and extract genotypes
steps.instruction: For each sample, preprocess the generated VCF files and extract the genotype status of every variant.

steps.title: Create union of unique variants
steps.instruction: Combine the variant lists from wxs‑normal, wxs‑tumor, and rnaseq‑tumor to produce a single set of all unique variant positions.

steps.title: Calculate sequencing coverage
steps.instruction: Compute the read coverage for each position in the union of unique variants across all samples.

steps.title: Merge genotype and coverage data
steps.instruction: For each sample, merge the genotype‑status file with the coverage file; set the status to "unknown" for any position with fewer than ten reads.

steps.title: Combine sample VCFs and insert missing calls
steps.instruction: Create a multi‑sample VCF by merging the variant‑status files from all samples; for positions marked unknown in wxs‑normal, insert calls from the corresponding wxs‑tumor sample, and if still unknown, insert calls from the rnaseq‑tumor sample.
